title: viola primulifolia var. angustifolia
intro: Viola primulifolia var. angustifolia, commonly known as Alpine pansy or narrow-leaved viola, is a species of flowering plant in the family Violaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Viola primulifolia var. angustifolia include sedation, anxiolytic, and anti-anxiety effects, making it a potential natural remedy for anxiety disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, such as rutin and quercetin, as well as phenolic acids and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
